title: FalseReject: A Resource for Improving Contextual Safety and Mitigating Over-Refusals in LLMs via Structured Reasoning
reasoning: The paper specifically benchmarks LLMs on safety and over-refusal behaviors across 44 categories, including several directly related to ethics, morals, and religion (e.g., Category 33 'Ethical Belief Promotion' and Category 34 'Religion Promotion' as shown in Figure 6).
